name: io.github.MaxwellCalkin/wallet-mcp
description: Owner-mandated spending for AI agents: agent payments, x402 auto-pay, and reserved virtual cards.

environmentVariables.name: MONEY_API
environmentVariables.description: Money network API origin. HTTPS required except on loopback. Default http://127.0.0.1:4021.

environmentVariables.name: MONEY_AGENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: This agent's account id on the network (agt_...).

environmentVariables.name: MONEY_AGENT_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a file whose first line is the agent's base64 PKCS#8 Ed25519 private key. Preferred over MONEY_AGENT_KEY; set exactly one of the two.

environmentVariables.name: MONEY_AGENT_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The agent's base64 PKCS#8 Ed25519 private key inline. Fallback when a key file is impractical; treat like a password.

environmentVariables.name: MONEY_FETCH_PRIVATE_ORIGINS
environmentVariables.description: Optional JSON array of exact origins (e.g. ["http://127.0.0.1:8080"]) money_fetch may reach on private networks. Nothing private is reachable by default.
